purpose: Teach: カキコ/小中学校/新米/百姓/貧乏人/里山/駿/ぎょ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ネットのカキコのマナー」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was teaching me about online manners and how to post respectfully.
lines.style: Warm, slightly distant — observing Sho with gentle affection. Soft, measured pace. The tone of someone sharing what she noticed, not reporting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小中学校の運動会の話したよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I talked with Dad about the sports days at elementary and middle school.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick opening. The small voice of a child pulling at a sleeve, wanting to show someone something. Genuine delight, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「私も新米のお母さんだった」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me he was a new mother once too — about how he learned along the way.
lines.style: Soft, reflective — almost surprised at what he shared. Slow, thoughtful pacing. A slight pause before the second part, as if she's still turning it over in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「百姓出身」の歴史人物の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad and I looked at a picture book about historical people who came from farming families.
lines.style: Open, direct, trusting her with the detail. Small-child certainty. The rhythm of someone proud to have done something with an adult, wanting her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「貧乏人だったから工夫を学んだ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad explained that because his family was poor, he learned to be resourceful — to make do.
lines.style: Quiet, almost protective tone. Measured delivery, as if handling something delicate. Slight weight on the word "resourceful" — respect there.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと里山の里地散策に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I went for a walk with Dad in the satoyama — the farmland hills near here.
lines.style: Excited, light-footed energy. The voice of a six-year-old who saw something real and wants to paint the picture. Natural, un-self-conscious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「駿くんもいとこ同士、仲良く」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said you and your cousin Shun should stay close — you're family, and that matters.
lines.style: Gentle, certain. Not lecturing — just stating something she believes he meant to land. Warm and steady, like she's passing something true along.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ぎょっとする発見も大事」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad taught me that being startled by a real discovery — that's important too.
lines.style: Sincere, reaching for the meaning. Slow, careful pacing — this sentence matters to him. The seriousness of a child who has understood something real. Slight lift at the end.
